name: LinkRivers Site Monitor
author: linkrivers

sections.description:
LinkRivers Site Monitor keeps your business website running smoothly with comprehensive monitoring that just works.

Perfect for local businesses:

  • Uptime Monitoring – Get alerted instantly when your website goes down
  • SSL Certificate Tracking – Never let your SSL expire unexpectedly
  • Page Speed Monitoring – Track how fast your site loads for real visitors
  • Core Web Vitals – Monitor Google’s key performance metrics (LCP, FID, CLS)
  • SEO Health – Autopilot suggests and fixes SEO issues automatically
  • Form Tracking – Know when visitors submit contact forms
  • Error Detection – Catch JavaScript errors before they affect customers

Autopilot Features:

LinkRivers Autopilot can automatically detect and fix common SEO issues:

  • Missing or poor meta descriptions
  • Broken links
  • Missing image alt text
  • Schema markup issues
  • Canonical URL problems

Choose between “Review Mode” (approve changes before they’re applied) or “Auto Mode” (fixes applied automatically).

Built for Non-Technical Users:

No complicated dashboards or technical jargon. Just a simple traffic light showing your website’s health status – green means everything’s good, yellow means attention needed, red means action required.

External Service Notice:

This plugin connects to the LinkRivers service (api.linkrivers.com) to:

  • Receive and store monitoring data
  • Process SEO analysis
  • Display metrics in your dashboard

A free LinkRivers account is required. View our Terms of Service and Privacy Policy.

Privacy

This plugin sends data to external servers (api.linkrivers.com). See our Privacy Policy for details on what data is collected and how it is used.

Data collected includes:
* Page load timing metrics
* Core Web Vitals measurements
* JavaScript error messages (not user data)
* Form submission events (metadata only, not form content)
* Basic browser/device information

No personal visitor data, form contents, or cookies are collected.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the linkriver folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
  3. Go to LinkRivers > Settings
  4. Enter your Site Key and API Key from your LinkRivers dashboard
  5. That’s it! Monitoring starts automatically

Getting Your Keys:

  1. Sign up at linkrivers.com
  2. Add your website in the dashboard
  3. Copy your Site Key and API Key from Settings > API Keys
  4. Paste them into the plugin settings
sections.faq:
Will this slow down my website?

No. The monitoring scripts are lightweight (under 5KB) and load asynchronously after your page content. They have zero impact on your page load speed or SEO.

What data do you collect?

We collect:
– Page load performance metrics (times, not content)
– JavaScript errors (error messages only)
– Form submission events (not the actual form data)
– Basic browser/device information

We never collect:
– Personal information from your visitors
– Form content or passwords
– Cookies or tracking data

Where is data sent?

All monitoring data is sent securely to api.linkrivers.com over HTTPS. This is required for the plugin to function. No data is shared with third parties.

Can I disable certain features?

Yes! Each monitoring feature can be enabled or disabled individually in the plugin settings.

Does it work with caching plugins?

Yes. LinkRivers works perfectly with all major caching plugins including WP Rocket, W3 Total Cache, LiteSpeed Cache, and others.

Does it work with other SEO plugins?

Yes! LinkRivers integrates with:
– Yoast SEO
– RankMath
– All in One SEO
– And works standalone if you don’t use an SEO plugin

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Monitoring will pause. You can reactivate at any time to resume. Your historical data is preserved in your LinkRivers dashboard.

What happens when I uninstall the plugin?

All plugin settings and locally stored data are removed from your WordPress database. Your historical data remains available in your LinkRivers dashboard.
